pages.title: Coins
pages.text: Copper, silver and gold. One coin gives 9 of the coin below it, and 9 coins make the coin above. These conversions are shapeless crafting recipes in the crafting grid.

pages.title: Price
pages.text: Price per unit: base x quality x season x saturation. Outside the optimal season x1.3, in peak season x0.85. Each sale adds a saturation point (-2 % of the price, 40 % at most), which loses 10 % per day. Copper benchmarks: tomato 6, butter 10, aged cheese 14, goat cheese 11. Command: /tv price.

pages.title: Reputation
pages.text: Five tiers: Unknown (0), Regular (50), Supplier (200), Reputed producer (500), Master farmer (1200). A trade with the guild merchant gives 1 point. A delivered contract gives 5 to 25; an accepted contract that expires costs 10.

pages.title: Contract board
pages.text: The board offers 3 contracts, renewed at dawn. Each asks for a product (often in season), a quantity and a minimum quality, and is due within 2 to 5 days. Deliver the item in hand, or the whole stock of the requested type.

pages.title: Stall and ledger
pages.text: The stall has 9 sale slots and a till. By day, a villager within 16 blocks buys one unit and pays 90 % of the price into the till. The ledger lists the ten highest prices.

pages.title: Guild and titles
pages.text: The guild desk's merchant offers trades from level 1 to 5, unlocked by reputation tier. Level 5 requires the guild seal. 256 units sold in one line grant a title: gardener, orchardist, herder, cheesemaker, beekeeper. Command: /tv titles.
